name: Wildbolt Storm
description:
You create a thunderous tempest which savagely attacks with lightning and wind with the size of a 40-foot-cube centered on a point in range. Each enemy creature in the area makes a {save}. On a failed save, it takes {dice} {type} damage and becomes Paralyzed. On a successful save, it takes half the damage and does not become Paralyzed.

A creature also makes that save if it enters the area or ends it turn there. A creature makes that save only once per turn.

When used during the rain, creatures have disadvantage on the save.
